# Independent scoped-policy compatibility

This development-only supplement adds validation of the public
`query-necessary-evidence-checks-v2` observation interface. It does not change
queries, judgments, splits, scores, 12,000-character context budgets or the
meaning of sufficient evidence. The v2.1 adapter and supplements, the original
baseline and the failed independent R1 result remain historical evidence.
R1 is now explicitly development material; R2 remains independently sealed.

The new verifier imports no product code and has no fixture IDs or relevance
labels. It independently derives the necessary requirements for the declared
bounded families: legacy witnesses, explicitly requested invoices and dated
completed restoration/hash-comparison actions. Necessary markers do not prove
an answer, authority or factual sufficiency.

Every claimed scoped observation must bind an exact range of the final emitted
excerpt and a recognized subject, action, document-kind or event-date marker.
Subject identity is token-bounded, other subjects cannot lend their actions or
dates, and quotations or mentions of an invoice do not establish document kind.
Negation, pending actions, conditions and denial in the same final-text sentence
cannot be laundered by selecting an inner positive-looking span. Absence needs
an explicit null range and cannot hide a recognized present marker.

The original literal role verifier remains separate. The new scope precedence
allows related material for a different requested subject, contradictory
material for a verified aligned negated action, and evidence candidates only
when no recognized necessary requirement or verified counterwitness fails.
Unknown or unsupported claims are errors, not automatic negative exclusions.

Positive sufficiency still requires a gold resource with its complete frozen
factual body actually emitted and valid citations/locators. Hydration alone is
not delivery. Legacy negative context selections are always retained separately
from unsupported sufficient evidence; no historical result is relabeled FP0.

The expanded diagnostic view contains the exact original DEV plus retired R1
union, with both provenance pins and bytes verified. Its original-DEV and
retired-R1 groups are reported separately, and its status is always development
only, never independent acceptance. Captured model metadata is recorded as a
producer claim; the measurement driver itself does not execute a model.
